decisions.reason: As a close-to-core formwork product that received its own web page across two years, it reflects visible investment and public commitment, so management is likely to persist with it in a growing market.

Although it was promoted less prominently than A or E, it still sits near the firm's established offer, and sunk development effort plus an expanding industry make continued support more likely than withdrawal.

This product combines strong fit with the firm's modular formwork business and a clear public commitment through dedicated presentation, which under escalation of commitment lowers the chance of abandonment.

F is somewhat more droppable because it was only mentioned rather than prominently featured and may overlap with other magnetic formwork items, but its proximity to the core business still makes continuation the more likely choice.
